psychological_meaning: Blue is often associated with feelings of calmness, serenity, and stability. It can also represent trust, loyalty, wisdom, confidence, intelligence, faith, truth, and heaven. Blue is considered beneficial to the mind and body, slowing human metabolism and producing a calming effect.
